lattice.config.latticeHome: Override the Lattice data directory (same as LATTICE_HOME). Empty = use `~/.lattice`.
lattice.config.minCliVersion: Minimum required Lattice runtime version. A warning is shown when the detected version is older.
lattice.config.autoRefresh: Automatically refresh views when files under the Lattice data directory change.
lattice.config.fallbackPollMs: Polling interval (ms) used when the file watcher is unavailable. 0 disables polling.
lattice.config.tasks.scope: Default scope of the Tasks view: all registered projects, or the active workspace project only.
lattice.config.tasks.showArchived: Show the archived group in the Tasks view.
lattice.config.search.types: Restrict search results to these types. Empty = all types.
lattice.config.search.limit: Per-type result limit for search. 0 = dynamic limit computed by the CLI.
lattice.config.graph.defaultLayout: Default layout used by the graph webview.
lattice.config.graph.keepContext: Keep the graph webview alive when hidden (uses more memory; state persistence is enabled by default without this).
lattice.config.statusBar.project: Show the active project item in the status bar.
lattice.config.statusBar.activeTasks: Show the active-tasks item in the status bar.
lattice.config.editor.specLinks: Turn `spec-xxxxxxxx` tokens in documents into clickable links.
lattice.config.decorations.enabled: Decorate files that fall into the active task's scope paths.
lattice.config.documents.ragHintOnSave: After saving a spec document, offer to run `spec migrate` and `rag update`.
lattice.config.trace: Verbose logging (CLI invocations, timings) in the Lattice output channel.
lattice.walkthrough.title: Get Started with Lattice
lattice.walkthrough.description: Wire your editor into Lattice's engineering memory: specs, tasks, decisions, search and the knowledge graph.
lattice.walkthrough.cli.title: Check the Lattice runtime
lattice.walkthrough.cli.description:
The extension reads Lattice data natively (in-process core).

[Check runtime](command:lattice.cli.check)
lattice.walkthrough.init.title: Initialize Lattice
lattice.walkthrough.init.description:
Create `~/.lattice` — either in-process (Quick Start: first user + project scan) or with the full `ltc init` (AI clients, git, templates).

[Quick Start (No CLI)](command:lattice.workspace.bootstrap) · [Full setup (ltc init)](command:lattice.workspace.initialize)
lattice.walkthrough.projects.title: Register projects
lattice.walkthrough.projects.description:
Register the active project or scan directories. Git projects use their fingerprint and do not need lattice.json; non-Git folders require an anchor. Multi-root workspaces and nested projects are supported.

[Register this project](command:lattice.workspace.link) · [Scan projects](command:lattice.workspace.scan) · [Open Configuration Center](command:lattice.config.open)
lattice.walkthrough.browse.title: Browse tasks & specs
lattice.walkthrough.browse.description:
Tasks (with PRD/design/progress), specs by scope and project relations live in the Lattice sidebar. Multi-select for batch actions, drag a task onto a project to associate it, and use the per-view search / filter icons in any title bar.

[Open the Tasks view](command:lattice.tasks.focus)
lattice.walkthrough.workflows.title: Task workflows
lattice.walkthrough.workflows.descriptio:
Long-text checkpoint drafts (write in an untitled Markdown document, commit straight to progress.yaml), Summarize Task drafts, batch actions and "copy task context" for AI prompts.

[New checkpoint draft](command:lattice.task.checkpoint.draft) · [Summarize task](command:lattice.task.summarize)
lattice.walkthrough.graph.title: Graph workbench
lattice.walkthrough.graph.description:
Explore tasks, projects and specs on the knowledge graph — filters, layouts, Git status for projects and a read-only detail panel. `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G` toggles it; the web workbench opens the same UI in-editor.

[Open the graph](command:lattice.graph.open) · [Open the web workbench](command:lattice.web.open)
lattice.walkthrough.search.title: Search & graph
lattice.walkthrough.search.description:
RAG + full-text search across tasks, specs, checkpoints and relations — with `#type` prefixes, inline actions and query history. Any view can be searched by content from its title bar.

[Search](command:lattice.search.open)
lattice.walkthrough.users.title: Multi-user
lattice.walkthrough.users.description:
The status bar shows the current user — switch, create or rename users, or browse another user's data read-only (every write is blocked).

[Manage users](command:lattice.user.manager)
